# Cogito Academy

> Find expert tutors, book lessons, and track achievements.

- App: https://app.cogitoacademy.id/
- Company: https://cogitoacademy.id/
- API: https://api.cogitoacademy.id (oRPC; procedure paths use slashes, e.g. `/rpc/auth/getProfile`; request bodies wrapped in `{"json": ...}`)

## Routes

- `/login` — sign in / sign up (public entry)
- `/dashboard` — role-specific home (student / tutor / admin)
- `/tutors` — tutor discovery (students)
- `/bookings` — booking list + detail (`/bookings/$bookingId`)
- `/calendar`, `/balance`, `/achievements`, `/knowledge-bank`, `/notifications`, `/profile`, `/guide`

## Stack

- Web: Vite SPA (TanStack Router + React Query), static nginx, no `/rpc` proxy
- API: Bun + Elysia, oRPC, Better Auth, Drizzle/Postgres, Redis
- CMS: Sanity (Knowledge Bank resources)
